notes: Content complexity is computed from ORIGINAL V0 quality class-ID masks, not ground truth.

Boundary complexity = horizontal+vertical class transitions divided by all horizontal+vertical adjacent pixel pairs. It describes this mask representation, not every aspect of visual/semantic complexity.
Each content/time correlation pairs one mask statistic per image with that image mean stage time over the two ABBA runs. All images are retained, including org-named files.
Same-image repeat std within each run is separate from across-image mean variation. Pooled six-observation std additionally contains ABBA run drift.
Pearson/Spearman are descriptive associations, not causal effects. No p-values or independence claims are used; image sequence and shared CPU/BPU load can confound them.
Detection and segmentation were enabled together in these runs. These correlations cannot attribute shared scheduling/CPU/BPU waits solely to segmentation content.
A small coefficient does not establish that image content has no timing influence; boundary transitions do not capture texture, logits or every branch.
BPU stage values are host submission/wait-related wall time, not pure hardware cycle counts.
No absolute segmentation accuracy or quality claim is made because no annotated ground truth is supplied.
